Evidence C appended: the cupy build failure is NOT macOS-specific. Reproduced on Windows during a live 1.3.0 portable install (RTX 4060 Ti, ComfyUI 0.29.2) with the root cause the macOS run never surfaced - cupy-wheel is a 2.9kB source-only shim whose setup.py imports pkg_resources, which modern setuptools no longer ships, so it fails on every platform on every fresh install until the curated set decides the question. Pins three requirements for the curated file: make cupy an explicit pin-or-drop rather than a leftover (never carry cupy-wheel, whose only job is the runtime CUDA detection the curated file replaces), constrain setuptools or ban source builds via --only-binary, and note this is another case of a failure reporting itself as success - 'Custom install command succeeded for ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation' is logged 400ms after the ERROR. Severity unchanged: wasteful, not broken.
